item.message: Code Mode is unavailable because code-mode host is disabled. Code mode will fail closed; enable `features.code_mode_host` and install `codex-code-mode-host`.

item.text: {"rule":"The procedure adaptively forced the ace of hearts: after the first tap it kept the selected pair if it contained the heart, otherwise discarded it; after the second tap it kept the tapped card if it was the heart, otherwise discarded it."}
